sources.snippet: Whisper-Large-V3-Turbo Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. Whisper large‑v3‑turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large‑v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4. sources.snippet: Whisper Large v3 Turbo is a speech-to-text model developed by OpenAI and released in October 2024. It is a distilled, faster variant of the Whisper Large v3 model, designed to reduce inference time while retaining strong transcription accuracy across a wide range of languages.
